name: Tinker pets stay passive when the player picks Passive (#7475)
contract: #7475 reports Tinker pets treat Passive like Defensive: they keep attacking and casting after the player sets Passive. The pet AI (npc_ascension_tinker_pet) promoted a passive spawn to defensive on its first update and wrote that into the pet bar, destroying a player-chosen Passive. A level 80 Tinker builds a Mechano-Bear (803405), which must still spawn defensive (#4074): pet_react_state is 1 (defensive). The player then issues the native Passive command (pet_stance 0): both the creature react state and the pet bar stored stance must stay 0 (passive), and while the Tinker attacks a dummy for ten seconds the dummy health must not move, proving the pet neither attacked nor cast. Setting Defensive again (pet_stance 1) must restore the #4074 behavior: the pet rejoins the fight and the dummy loses health.
